issues.detail: The Greek 'αξια γαρ ων επραξαμεν' means 'for we have acted worthily of them' (referring to the preceding subjects/actions). The Vietnamese translation 'chịu xứng với việc mình đã làm' translates it as 'worthy of what we did', which reverses the relationship. The Greek indicates the actions were worthy of the persons/things mentioned previously, not that the actions were worthy of themselves.
